ctx.x: I once made a record of him when he was pretty deaf in the end. He didn't have teeth, you know. He played little though. You all get anything on Buddy Petit? Some people tell us about him, but not so many facts yet, you know. Just we don't know exactly how old he was or things of that kind. Of course, it's hard to find, trace those things. Kid Rene? Kid Rene. We talked to his brother. Joe? Mm-hmm.
Did you work with Buddy Petit much?
I played a few jobs. I don't see how I was in the band at all. The other guys couldn't play well that high, you know.
